history.operation: new lifestyle photograph from physical product references
history.exact_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium yet approachable DearBody Philippines product-detail website header. Create a BRAND NEW real lifestyle campaign photograph, landscape exactly 2:1, around 1774 by 887 pixels, no text overlay, no border. This is a six-product campaign: fun, vibrant, warm, LIGHT, bright daytime energy with real skin texture, believable contemporary Filipino everyday life, not moody luxury.
COMPOSITION IS ESSENTIAL: camera pulled back to a medium-wide environmental portrait. Only ONE adult person total. Put the subject, entire arms/action and all visual activity only in the right-hand 48% (x52–95%). Leave left45% as an actual quiet warm-cream plaster wall with subtle natural sunlight, no props, no letters, no person. Full hair/head visible with at least12–15% picture-height clear headroom. Face center x75%, y28%; naturally held small perfume bottle centered around x72%, y50%. Face and complete bottle entirely within x65–85% so they survive a narrow portrait crop. Keep bottle and both hands above y65%. Leave the top of the head, eyes, and all bottle edges well inside the image. Do not enlarge the person to fill the full height. No tight headshot. One coherent daylight source, uplifting exposure, controlled vibrant wardrobe/props; rich but natural burgundy, coral, golden warm accents against cream; no orange monochrome filter.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: First attached image is the authoritative raw SKU photograph for label, liquid, bottle, cap, brand, name. Second attached image is canonical bottle geometry ONLY: do NOT copy Sunset Cocktail wording/color/background. Preserve a tall straight-sided cylindrical glass 50ml body, restrained rounded shoulder, narrow neck, thick transparent glass base and a compact glossy BLACK cylindrical magnetic cap with a plain black lower edge. Small realistic 50ml scale in an adult hand, about one palm-length, never a giant bottle. Product label faces camera naturally, unobstructed, with exact spelling and original label layout. Preserve original small PARFUM / LONDON mark. Do not invent claims, text, engravings, hardware or extra packaging. Cap is fitted unless the individual scene explicitly calls for sprayer. Do not attach a silver ring to the cap. The tiny silver line below the seated cap belongs to the bottle collar.
Must look photographable: natural anatomy and hand grip, five plausible fingers per hand, no fused arms, no repeated objects, no floating props. No extra people anywhere, including reflections, photographs, screens, posters, silhouette crowds or partial bodies. No mirrors. Do not bake any headline, tagline, typography, watermark or website UI into the photo. Only the real physical product label contains text.
